Company description: PG (Generated via gemini-3.5-flash-lite)

The Procter & Gamble Company, trading under the ticker PG, is a leading multinational consumer goods corporation headquartered in Cincinnati, Ohio. Founded in 1837 by candle maker William Procter and soap maker James Gamble, the company initially grew by supplying provisions and soap to the Union Army during the American Civil War. Over nearly two centuries, Procter & Gamble has evolved into a global powerhouse in the fast-moving consumer goods sector. Its comprehensive business model focuses on the development, marketing, and distribution of branded products across distinct segments, including beauty, grooming, health care, fabric and home care, and baby, feminine, and family care. The company manages a vast portfolio of globally recognized household names, such as Tide, Pampers, Gillette, Crest, and Pantene, which are sold in approximately 180 countries. Procter & Gamble distinguishes itself through sustained investments in research and development, supply chain optimization, and large-scale marketing strategies, enabling it to maintain market leadership and consistently deliver value to its global consumer base and shareholders.
